findings.evidence:
`pkg/expression/expression.go:815` adds `(*Assignment).Clone()` and unconditionally calls `a.Expr.Clone()` (`pkg/expression/expression.go:819`).
`pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:3838` builds `Insert.OnDuplicate` assignments with `Expr: expr` and `LazyErr: err`; for the special-cased `ErrSubqueryMoreThan1Row`, it keeps `err` and continues (`pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:3840`), meaning `expr` can be nil.
`rewriteExprNode()` returns `(nil, nil, err)` when the rewriter hits an error (`pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go:304-306`). One concrete producer is scalar-subquery preprocessing: it executes `EvalSubqueryFirstRow(...)` and propagates its error (incl. `ErrSubqueryMoreThan1Row`) (`pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go:1346-1349`).
Plan-cache cloning hits this path: `Insert.CloneForPlanCache` clones `OnDuplicate` via `util.CloneAssignments` (`pkg/planner/core/plan_clone_generated.go:462-468`), which calls `a.Clone()` for each assignment (`pkg/planner/util/misc.go:96-105`). If `a.Expr == nil`, this panics.
findings.fix:
Make `(*expression.Assignment).Clone()` nil-safe for `Expr` (and ideally `Col`) so lazy-error assignments clone without panicking, e.g.:
- If `a == nil` return nil.
- If `a.Col != nil` clone it, else keep nil.
- If `a.Expr != nil` clone it, else keep nil.
Optionally also harden `util.CloneAssignments` to tolerate nil elements.
findings.impact: With instance plan cache enabled, cloning a cached `Insert` plan containing `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` assignments that carry `LazyErr` (e.g. deferred `ErrSubqueryMoreThan1Row`) can panic during `CloneForPlanCache`, turning an expected conditional runtime error into a panic/failure before duplicate detection. This can break cross-session plan reuse and can surface as a server-side panic in the plan-cache clone path.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked later history up to `upstream-master` (`6d5529545b451c376b2e9bba31620bab34430fa7`): `upstream-master:pkg/expression/expression.go` still has `Expr: a.Expr.Clone()` without a nil guard, and `upstream-master` still documents that `asgn.Expr` can be nil when `LazyErr` exists (moved file: `upstream-master:pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_common_plans.go`).
findings.verify:
Add a regression test that:
- Enables instance plan cache and `EnablePlanCacheForSubquery`.
- Prepares an `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE col = (SELECT ...)` where the scalar subquery can trigger `ErrSubqueryMoreThan1Row` during preprocessing.
- Executes in session 1 to populate the instance cache, then executes in session 2 to force `CloneForPlanCache`.
Expect: no panic during clone; statement only errors when the duplicate-update path is actually taken.
findings.what: `(*expression.Assignment).Clone()` can panic when cloning lazy-error `ON DUPLICATE` assignments because it unconditionally calls `a.Expr.Clone()` even though `Expr` is allowed to be nil when `LazyErr` is set (deferred `ErrSubqueryMoreThan1Row` path). This breaks `Insert.CloneForPlanCache` (and any other use of `util.CloneAssignments`) under instance plan cache.

subject: planner: use code-gen to generate CloneForPlanCache method for Insert/Update/Delete (#55185)
summary: Code-gen-based `CloneForPlanCache` is added for `Insert/Update/Delete` plus new cloning helpers, but `expression.Assignment.Clone()` is not nil-safe for `Expr`. This can panic during instance plan-cache cloning for `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` when assignments defer `ErrSubqueryMoreThan1Row` via `LazyErr` (i.e., `Expr == nil`).
